sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Distribution of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended; Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs); Grand-Ducal Regulation of 11 July 2019 on the functioning of the RBE register; CSSF Regulation No 12-02 on mandatory customer due diligence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity card of each intended manager and shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent civil-status authority of the country of nationality

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of non-money laundering background / police record (extrait du casier judiciaire) for each manager and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent judicial authority in the country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original notarized excerpt of corporate register (Registry Extract) for each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry in the shareholder's country of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft articles of association (statuts) prepared in French
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Authentic notarial deed; no apostille applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank certificate of capital blocking (attestation de blocage de fonds)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg credit institution where share capital is deposited
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank-certified professional letter; no apostille required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory real-time screening of all managers, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners against the CSSF AML/CFT framework, OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, UK HMT sanctions list, and the Luxembourg Ministry of Finance national asset-freeze list. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons, persons connected to high-risk jurisdictions, and any transaction involving pharmaceutical API trade with counterparties not compliant with FATF recommendations. Periodic rescreening must be performed at least every six months and upon any material change in ownership or control.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) online portal – lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be written in Latin script using Luxembourgish, French, German, or English. The required legal-form suffix 'SARL' or the full French form 'Société à responsabilité limitée' must appear in the name. Names must be distinctive and capable of indicating the commercial activity without misleading the public. If a foreign script is used, a Latin-script transliteration must be provided.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant may submit a formal written challenge through the LBR portal within 15 days, attaching the identical proposed name and legal grounds for distinctiveness. If the rejection is sustained, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Minister of Justice. The final remedy is an action for annulment before the administrative court (Tribunal administratif) in Luxembourg City, to be lodged within three months of notification of the appellate rejection.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A domiciliation agreement with a licensed domiciliation agent is initially accepted for the registered office of a SARL. However, given the regulated pharmaceutical API wholesale activity under ISIC 4649, the Ministry of Health and the Luxembourg tax administration will require a physical operating address, functional professional premises, and adequate storage/logistics facilities. Purely virtual offices without local operational substance are not acceptable for licensing and compliance purposes.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High — approximately 80% risk of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first two years after obtaining wholesale authorization. The Luxembourg Health Inspectorate, the Customs and Excise Administration, and the Social Security administration conduct regular physical inspections for pharmaceutical distributors.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Civil-law notary fee for authentic execution of incorporation deed, including drafting of articles of association and review of corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial scale tariff; prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Luxembourg Business Registers filing, name reservation, and RCS registration fee
Publication of incorporation notice in the Recueil des Sociétés et Associations (RSA)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Recueil des Sociétés et Associations (RSA), Mémorial Luxembourg

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation service — first-year fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Approved domiciliation company licensed under the Law of 31 May 1999

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank capital deposit and blocking certificate fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg credit institution selected by shareholders

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization processing for origin corporate documents and police certificates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Hague Apostille sealing) or relevant consular authorities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee schedule and courier costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed compliance service provider and notary office

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: General legal consultancy for UBO piercing, structural review, tax pre-clearance, and start-up registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Law firm (cabinet d'avocats) with Luxembourg bar qualification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; fixed fee for pre-incorporation scope

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Loi modifiée du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), Articles 710-1 to 733 (SARL régime); Law of 19 December 2006 on company modernization; Law of 30 September 2020 on business establishment permits; Law of 7 November 1996 on the organisation of the pharmaceutical sector, as amended (pharma wholesale licensing).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), 18 Rue Erasme, L-2082 Luxembourg.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte constitutif (notarial deed of incorporation) deposited with the RCS, with subsequent mandatory publication in the Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: SARL minimum share capital is EUR 12,000 (approx. USD 13,100), fully subscribed at incorporation. Each cash share must be paid up to at least 25% of nominal value at subscription, with the balance due within five years. The capital is deposited into a blocked escrow bank account ('compte bloqué') opened with a Luxembourg or EU credit institution and released only upon RCS registration; non-cash contributions require a statutory auditor's valuation report.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the notarial deed of incorporation of the Société à Responsabilité Limitée, with share capital fully subscribed and paid in accordance with Articles 710-1 et seq. of the Law of 10 August 1915, is hereby ratified. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company is fixed at [registered address], Grand-Duchy of Luxembourg, and adopted as the official siège social for commercial, fiscal, and regulatory purposes. RESOLVED, that [Name], acting as gérant, is appointed sole director with exclusive signature power and full authority to open bank accounts, procure wholesale distribution licences for pharmaceutical APIs, and file all statutory declarations with the RCS, tax authorities, and Ministry of Health.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Availability Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) online portal, RCS Luxembourg (lbr.lu / rcs.lu).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal name-reservation request through the LBR e-service or instruct a notary to reserve the name. Provide at least two proposed variants bearing the mandatory 'SARL' suffix. The RCS screens the proposed names against existing registers for identity or confusing similarity and issues a name-clearance certificate. Ensure the name is compatible with the pharmaceutical wholesale object and does not mislead as to an unreceived authorization.
required_dossiers: Notarized power of attorney (if filed through agent/notary)
Copy of valid identity documents of all incorporators
At least two proposed company name variants with SARL suffix
Statement of corporate object (ISIC 4649 API wholesale)
Name-reservation application form (LBR template)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS flags similarity or inadmissibility, file two alternative name variants within five business days or furnish written consent from the holder of the conflicting name; a formal administrative review may be requested through the RCS Registry Office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Blocked Escrow Account and Deposit of Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: CSSF-supervised credit institution in Luxembourg (e.g., banque agréée) providing the capital-blocking certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a blocked account in the name of the future 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' (name reservation certificate attached), deposit the minimum share capital of EUR 12,000, and obtain a bank attestation confirming receipt and irrevocable blocking of the funds until the RCS issues the registration certificate. The attestation must identify all subscribers and the amounts subscribed.
required_dossiers: Company name-reservation certificate from the RCS
Draft notarial deed of incorporation
Identity documents of subscribers and beneficial owners
Bank account application and AML/KYC forms
Source-of-funds declarations and supporting evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises AML or source-of-funds queries, provide notarized supporting documentation, audited financial statements, or contractual evidence of lawful origin; if rejected, open the account with another CSSF-licensed bank and re-supply the blocking certificate before the notarial signing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Notarial Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary, under the supervision of the Chambre des Notaires du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the draft statutes, bank capital-blocking certificate, and identity documents to the appointed notary. The notary verifies legal compliance with the Law of 10 August 1915, the corporate object's lawfulness, capital subscription and payment, and the appointment of managers. The deed is signed before the notary in person or through a notarized power of attorney.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of incorporation (statuts)
Bank attestation of share capital deposit on blocked account
Company name-reservation certificate
Valid identity documents of incorporators
Acceptance of office declarations for managers (gérants)
Lease or domiciliation agreement for registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requires legal adjustments to the statutes, sign a rectifying addendum (acte rectificatif) and reschedule the signing within 48 hours; unresolved objections may be escalated to the Chambre des Notaires.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing with RCS Luxembourg and Publication in RESA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) electronic filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary electronically files the notarial deed, statutory extracts, and manager identifications through the LBR e-justice portal and pays the EUR 75 electronic filing fee. Upon verification, the RCS registers the company, issues the certificate of registration (certificat RCS), and publishes the statutory particulars in the RESA. The company acquires legal personality upon registration.
required_dossiers: Notarial deed of incorporation (acte constitutif)
Declaration of appointment and acceptance by managers
Copy of civil identification documents of managers
Registered-office irrevocable consent from the lessor/domiciliation provider
Proof of payment of RCS filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query ('mesure d'instruction'), provide the requested affidavits, translations, or supplementary documents within the stated deadline (generally one month); if the filing is rejected, correct the omissions through the notary and re-file the identical instrument without re-execution where permissible.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, VAT, and Social Security Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'Enregistrement, des Domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT; Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) for corporate income tax; Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS) for employer registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RCS registration, apply to the AEDT for a Luxembourg VAT identification number, notify the ACD of the company's tax domicile and first taxable period, and register as an employer with the CCSS. Appoint a statutory auditor (réviseur d'entreprises agréé) if balance-sheet thresholds are met or if required by the notarial deed; request an EORI number if the API wholesale activity involves intra-Community or third-country imports.
required_dossiers: RCS registration certificate
Notarial deed of incorporation
Identities and eligibility declarations of managers
Registered-office evidence
Bank account details and capital payment proof
EORI application (if importing APIs)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEDT/ACD delays the VAT number, produce the RCS certificate and notarial deed as conclusive evidence of existence and request expedition through the taxpayer service window; VAT registration is retroactively effective to the incorporation date; CCSS registration may be cured by filing a late-registration declaration with penalty waiver request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Establishment Permit and Pharmaceutical API Wholesale Distribution Authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministère de l'Économie (establishment permit under the Law of 30 September 2020); Direction de la Santé – Division de la Pharmacie et des Médicaments, Ministère de la Santé (wholesale distribution authorization for active pharmaceutical ingredients).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the establishment-permit application (licence d'établissement) for the commercial wholesale activity to the Ministry of the Economy. Concurrently, file the wholesale-distribution authorization dossier with the Ministry of Health under the Pharmaceutical Law and Directive 2001/83/EC, covering the premises qualification, GDP-compliant storage and transport procedures, responsible pharmacist, pharmacovigilance system, and, for imported APIs, the Article 111 written confirmation from each third-country manufacturer.
required_dossiers: RCS registration certificate
Notarial deed and registered-office consent
Criminal-record extracts (casier judiciaire) of managers and responsible person
Professional diploma and qualification proof of the responsible pharmacist
Site plan, lease title, and structural conformity documents
GDP policy and standard operating procedures (storage, transport, recalls)
API importation list with manufacturer written confirmations (per Article 111 of Directive 2001/83/EC)
Pharmacovigilance master file and qualified-person appointment
Public-liability and product-liability insurance certificates
Establishment-permit application form (Ministry of Economy)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the Ministry's requests for supplementary information within 15–30 calendar days; if the authorization is refused, file an administrative appeal with the Tribunal administratif within three months; alternatively, apply for a provisional restricted authorization limited to bonded warehousing while the full GDP dossier is completed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de la Santé – Direction de la Santé, Division de la Pharmacie et des Médicaments, jointly with the Ministère de l'Économie for the establishment permit under the Law of 30 September 2020.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation de distribution en gros de substances actives pharmaceutiques (API) / Wholesale Distribution Authorization for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, issued pursuant to the amended Law of 7 November 1996 and Directive 2001/83/EC, read with the establishment licence (licence d'établissement).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'Environnement (Luxembourg Environmental Protection Agency), Ministère de l'Environnement, du Climat et du Développement durable.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 – environmental notice (déclaration) applicable to standalone pharmaceutical API warehousing and wholesale distribution without manufacturing, repackaging, or blending; full Environmental Impact Assessment (évaluation des incidences sur l'environnement) is not required for pure storage of sealed, packaged APIs under the Law of 1 August 2007 on environmental authorizations; any compounding or repackaging activity re-classifies the site to Category 3 requiring a full environmental authorization.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero uncontrolled wastewater discharge: compliance with EU Directive 91/271/EEC municipal pre-treatment thresholds (pH 6.5–9.5, COD ≤ 1,000 mg/L, TSS ≤ 350 mg/L) before sewer release; VOC emissions below 20 mg C/Nm³ at non-methane sources; sealed-container storage and secondary containment; hazardous pharmaceutical waste must be surrendered to a licensed waste carrier under the Luxembourg waste-management regime with full manifest documentation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety attestation from the Inspection Générale de la Protection Civile (Ministry of Home Affairs), including fire-resistance ratings, extinguishing systems, and chemical-storage segregation; structural load and stability clearance by an approved technical control bureau (bureau de contrôle agréé, e.g., Secolux); workplace safety authorization from the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) under the Labor Code, with mandatory Safety Data Sheets (SDS), chemical hazard signage, personnel protective-equipment plans, and occupational medical surveillance records.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) – VAT registration and indirect tax administration; Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) – corporate income tax administration; central government e-portal: MyGuichet.lu / Guichet.lu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-established foreign entity must file Form 31 with the AEDT to obtain a Luxembourg VAT identification number, providing evidence of identity, constitutional documents, proof of business activity, and expected turnover. The AEDT issues an 8-digit VAT ID prefixed 'LU'. A Luxembourg-incorporated SARL first obtains a national business registration number from the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register and then registers for VAT and corporate tax through the competent offices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg does not provide a check-the-box or similar pass-through election for a SARL. Qualifying resident parent companies may elect fiscal unity (intégration fiscale) for CIT purposes with their 95%-owned subsidiaries, simultaneously covering corporate income tax, municipal business tax, and net wealth tax. Hybrid mismatch elections are governed by ATAD-aligned provisions and generally not available to alter entity classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Luxembourg VAT Law of 12 February 1979 and the EU VAT Directive
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover for established taxable persons; non-established suppliers and distance sellers are subject to mandatory registration without a local turnover threshold, subject to EU One-Stop-Shop schemes and the EUR 10,000 EU-wide distance-sales threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No general real-time fiscal clearance or API stamping mandate for B2B issuance. B2G invoicing is mandatory in EN 16931 PEPPOL electronic format. B2B electronic invoicing is permitted with recipient consent and must support complete audit trails. VAT returns, EC Sales Lists, and export declarations are filed electronically via MyGuichet.lu and EU reporting systems.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to the physical export of goods to a destination outside the EU, provided the goods leave EU territory and are documented within 90 days of supply. Intra-Community supplies to EU VAT-registered customers are also subject to the zero rate where the customer provides a valid EU VAT ID. Offshore B2B services are outside the scope of Luxembourg VAT if the place of supply is deemed to be the customer's establishment outside the EU.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document) with MRN
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing departure from EU territory
CMR transport contract or equivalent proof of carriage
Inward Remittance Certificate for export proceeds received in Luxembourg
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Luxembourg VAT authority may retrospectively audit export substantiation. Missing or unsatisfactory evidence triggers reversal of the zero rate, assessment of VAT at 17%, late interest of 0.8% per month, and administrative penalties ranging from 10% to 50% of the underpaid tax. Fraudulent export zero-rating claims may be prosecuted as criminal tax fraud, with fines up to EUR 240,000 and custodial penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), established by the Law of 22 April 1998, is the national central bank and a member of the Eurosystem. The Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) is the competent prudential and AML/CFT supervisory authority, while the European Central Bank (ECB) exercises direct prudential supervision over significant Luxembourg credit institutions under the Single Supervisory Mechanism (SSM). The BCL operates the TARGET2 euro large-value payment and settlement system in Luxembourg, collects balance-of-payments statistics, and executes monetary policy; the CSSF enforces the Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended, together with CSSF Regulation 12-02 and subsequent AML/CFT circulars.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible in Luxembourg for current-account and capital-account transactions. Article 63 TFEU prohibits restrictions on capital movements and payments between EU Member States and between Member States and third countries, subject only to EU-wide sanctions, counter-terrorism financing measures and public-policy exceptions. No exchange-control permit, prior approval, registration, waiting period or repatriation fee applies to equity injections, shareholder loans, trade settlements, dividend distributions or capital repayment. Dividends remitted to a non-resident shareholder are subject to Luxembourg withholding tax at 15% in the absence of relief, reduced or abolished under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (0% after a 12-month minimum holding period, provided substance and beneficial-ownership conditions are met) or under applicable double-tax treaties. The only practical frictions are documentary: banks require a payment-purpose statement, source-of-funds evidence and sanctions screening to satisfy BCL balance-of-payments statistics and CSSF AML obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Luxembourg imposes no mandatory surrender of export proceeds, no statutory repatriation timeline and no compulsory conversion ratio. As a euro-area member, euro-denominated export receipts require no conversion, and non-euro proceeds are freely retained or converted. The applicable obligations are documentary and AML-driven: export proceeds must be credited through a supervised Luxembourg or EU credit/payment institution; transaction-level documentary evidence, including sales contracts, commercial invoices, customs Single Administrative Documents (SAD), Intrastat declarations for EU dispatches, bills of lading and batch certificates of analysis under Directive 2011/62/EU, must be retained for at least five years; and payments above the reporting threshold (€12,500 per individual transaction) are captured by the servicing bank in the BCL balance-of-payments reporting. Commercial terms should require settlement within open-account or documentary-credit maturities consistent with bank working-capital facilities.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE – Spuerkeess)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account / Trade Finance
Operational Current Account / Trade Finance and Documentary Letter of Credit Desk
Operational Account / USD Liquidity and Clearing Conduit

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as the primary operating and treasury account; MEDIUM only as a supplementary collection rail. Luxembourg-licensed electronic money institutions (EMIs), including PayPal (Europe) S.à r.l. and Mangopay S.A., and passported EU EMIs such as Revolut Business, Airwallex and Currencycloud, may provide EUR IBANs, SEPA and SWIFT execution and digital onboarding; however, the ISIC 4649 pharma-API wholesale profile is an EBA-recognized high-risk sector for counterfeit medicines, product diversion and trade-based money laundering, and EMIs generally reject or heavily restrict API wholesalers. Legal constraints under the Law of 10 November 2009 on payment services, as amended by PSD2, and the EU E-Money Directive prohibit EMIs from granting credit, issuing documentary letters of credit or holding pre-incorporation capital escrow. The treasury architecture must therefore place all material liquidity, escrow, trade-finance, LC and FX-hedging flows with a Tier 1 Luxembourg credit institution; EMIs should be limited to low-value collections with automated reconciliation and immediate repassaging to the primary bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Statutory remote onboarding is possible in Luxembourg, but for a high-risk pharmaceutical API wholesale SARL the major Luxembourg commercial banks impose a de facto physical-presence mandate: at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner(s) must attend an in-person KYC interview at the bank's premises or at the SARL's registered office in Luxembourg before account activation; remote video onboarding, if offered, is limited to additional signatories and requires certified passports, notarized powers of attorney and the prior physical interview of the principal contact. The CSSF's risk-based expectations under the Law of 12 November 2004 and CSSF Regulation 12-02 require the bank to verify the SARL's economic substance, the identities and backgrounds of all directors and UBOs, the source of the initial capital and the commercial rationale of the API wholesale business. The mandatory interview dossier includes original or certified passports, RCS excerpt, articles of association, RBE certificate, tax residency certificates, a signed AML compliance declaration, and the notary's confirmation of the blocked-account release.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Industry risk classification: wholesale distribution of active pharmaceutical ingredients (ISIC 4649) is treated as a high-risk sector for counterfeit medicines, product diversion, over/under-invoicing and sanctions evasion, automatically triggering enhanced due diligence (EDD).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full statutory dossier: Luxembourg Ministry of Health (Direction de la Santé – Division de la Pharmacie et des Médicaments) wholesale distribution authorization or registration under Directive 2001/83/EC as transposed; EU Good Distribution Practice (GDP) certification or the complete documented GDP compliance programme under Directive 2011/62/EU; batch-level certificates of analysis; controlled-drug and precursor-chemical controls under EU Regulation 273/2004; ISO 9001/13485 certifications; standard operating procedures for supply-chain verification, anti-counterfeit testing and product recalls.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border exposure to India, China and emerging-market suppliers and customers, creating credible sanctions, corruption and product-quality risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Counterparty due-diligence file containing executed supply and distribution agreements with Incoterms 2020, counterparty bank references and entity registration extracts, customs and AEO certificates, beneficial-ownership lists, sanctions and PEP screening results against EU consolidated sanctions lists and OFAC for USD flows, negative-media reports, anti-bribery and corruption warranties, and a written undertaking that all remittances will be made exclusively to the contractual counterparty's named bank account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transfer-pricing and trade-valuation mismatch: banks reject clients when invoice values cannot be reconciled with customs declarations, market benchmarks or financial capacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OECD-compliant transfer-pricing documentation for wholesale distribution, including a benchmark study of gross or net margin within the pharma-API trading range; a reconciliation model linking purchase orders, shipping bills, customs SAD/Intrastat declarations, bills of lading, certificates of analysis and supplier invoices; auditor's statement confirming valuation consistency; no cash payouts and no split payments to multiple beneficiaries for a single invoice.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity or insufficient Luxembourg substance: the SARL is held by a corporate parent with minimal local activity, a typology associated with shell companies and tax evasion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RBE (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) extract identifying every UBO above 25%; group legal-entity structure chart; shareholder register of the parent; tax residency certificates; audited or reviewed opening/current financial statements; proof of Luxembourg substance, including lease agreement, employees or administrative agent, professional liability insurance and a local telephone/address trace; full CVs and professional references of the effective manager and UBO; signed declaration appointing a Luxembourg AML compliance contact.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts (balance sheet, profit and loss, notes) and management report where applicable, filed with RCSL and published in the RESA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Register of Commerce and Companies (RCSL) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after shareholder approval, and no later than seven months after the financial year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors are liable to fines of EUR 500–5,000; persistent non-filing may trigger court-ordered dissolution and public non-compliance notices

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax and municipal business tax return (combined declaration, Form 100)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Direct Tax Administration (Administration des contributions directes – ACD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within five months of fiscal year-end; calendar-year taxpayers must file by 31 May, with an administrative extension up to seven months available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a surcharge of up to 10% of the assessed tax, monthly default interest, and potential ex officio assessment

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual net wealth tax return (Form 200), including minimum net wealth tax computation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted together with the income tax return; same five-month statutory deadline for calendar-year taxpayers (31 May), extendable to seven months
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharges and default interest apply as for income tax; failure to file may lead to ex officio assessment and loss of deduction reliefs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership (UBO) register verification and update filing with the RBE
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Beneficial Ownership Register (RBE), administered by RCSL
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of any relevant change; no annual form if data is unchanged, but annual verification is required during the corporate compliance review
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to EUR 25,000 for non-filing or false information; criminal prosecution for intentional violations

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory annual independent audit by a certified réviseur d'entreprises if the company exceeds two of the three following thresholds: net turnover > EUR 11,000,000; balance sheet total > EUR 4,400,000; average workforce > 50 employees. Below these thresholds, audit is optional subject to shareholder, loan, or regulatory requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP in accordance with the Law of 19 December 2002 on annual accounts, following the Luxembourg chart of accounts; IFRS is permitted for EU-listed entities or where group consolidation requires.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: UBO information filed with the RBE must be kept accurate at all times; changes are reported within one month. No standalone annual UBO declaration exists, but an annual verification must be performed by the registered agent and documented in the corporate minutes during the annual compliance cycle.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 8,000 – USD 35,000 depending on size, operational complexity, and financial statement volume

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (Luxembourg City aggregate rate: 17% corporate income tax + 7% solidarity surcharge + approximately 6.75% municipal business tax; the municipal component varies by commune)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holidays. Principal preferential deductions: 80% exemption for qualifying IP income under the Luxembourg IP box, resulting in an effective rate below 5% on eligible IP; 100% participation exemption for qualifying dividends and capital gains; notional interest deduction on qualifying increases in net equity; investment tax credit and innovation incentives. An API wholesale trading company must satisfy real economic substance and qualifying taxpayer conditions to apply these preferences.
